description: This PHP test class verifies the LDAP connection and configuration in the OrangeHRM system. It specifically tests the LDAP connection API endpoint, mocking LDAP services and validating the success response based on configured LDAP server settings.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LDAP test connection API endpoint in OrangeHRM, employing mock LDAP services and environment setup.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Set up the test environment, check if LDAP server is configured, and initialize server config.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Test the creation of LDAP connection and its validation through mocked services, verifying the normalized response matches expected LDAP connection checks.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper to create a mock EntryCollection containing LDAP entries, associated with lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generate LDAP Entry objects for given username list, used in testing LDAP search callback responses.
